_readme: Evidence for every H3 capability claim CineBraid relies on.
This is the pattern every future model pack follows. It records WHERE a fact came
from, not the vendor's documentation itself: primary sources are cited and
1. A claim with no primary source does not appear in model-packs/minimax-h3.js.
It appears in notEstablished below, and the pack treats it as unsupported.
2. A provider's constraint is not a model fact. fal's 2,000-character queue schema
and MiniMax's 7,000-character model limit are separate rows for that reason.
3. Local open-weight capability and hosted API capability are recorded separately.
The open weights are H3-Base; two of the three modules the hosted 2K workflow
uses are not open-sourced, so a local install is a different capability set and

capabilities.claim: Text-to-video is supported.
First-frame (image-to-video) is supported.
First-and-last-frame is supported.
Last-frame-only is supported; FL2VA accepts zero, one or two images.
capabilities.note: CineBraid does not yet offer a last-frame-only workflow; the capability is recorded, not exposed.

capabilities.claim: Reference-to-video is supported, on a different checkpoint.
Reference images per generation.
Reference video clips per generation.
capabilities.note: Each clip 2-15s; combined reference video no more than 15s.

capabilities.claim: Reference audio clips per generation.
capabilities.note: Each clip 2-15s; combined no more than 15s.

capabilities.claim: Total reference files across all modalities.
Audio cannot be the only reference input.
Output duration range in seconds.
capabilities.note: The API reference states integer seconds only.

capabilities.claim: Frame rate.
Native audio is generated with the video.
Speech and lip-sync languages.
Aspect ratios.
Text-to-video requires an explicit ratio and cannot use adaptive.
A mode with an image input takes its ratio from that image.
Maximum prompt length accepted by the model.
capabilities.note: A MODEL limit. Backend limits are separate; see providerConstraints.

capabilities.claim: Resolutions available on the open-weight local path.
Resolutions available on the hosted API.

notEstablished.claim: Seed or any other deterministic-reproduction control.
notEstablished.cineBraidBehaviour: The capability flag is false. A supplied seed produces an unsupported coverage entry and a warning; no seed is invented in the request.

notEstablished.claim: Whether a local SGLang, vLLM, diffusers or ComfyUI deployment exposes duration, fps or resolution as caller arguments.
notEstablished.status: the model card documents deployment but not a per-call argument list
notEstablished.cineBraidBehaviour: The local surface declares only what the model card establishes: 768p, 24fps, 4-15s.

notEstablished.claim: Whether a hosted route operated by a third party runs H3-Context-IR before H3-Base.
notEstablished.status: not a MiniMax fact; it is a property of each backend
notEstablished.cineBraidBehaviour: Serialisation is chosen by surface. The hosted surface emits prose sections; the local surface emits the documented H3-Base three-field document.

notEstablished.status: no official source documents a weight parameter
notEstablished.cineBraidBehaviour: referenceWeights is false, so a weighted reference is refused by the capability check rather than silently dropped.

positions.scope: fal queue schema, recorded in data/model-profiles.json

conflicts.resolution: Both are kept. The pack warns at the model limit; a backend adapter applies its own. Neither is written into the other's layer.
Recorded per surface. A local install is not offered 2K, because the module that produces it is not open-sourced.
The pack uses the official 4s floor. The existing prompt profiles are left untouched in this phase; they belong to the prompt-authoring registry, and changing them is a separate, wider change.

promptingPolicySources.cameraExpression: prompt-guide-base: motion type, amplitude and speed, written as prose within the shot rather than stacked labels.
promptingPolicySources.shotChronology: prompt-guide-base: the first shot carries no timestamp; later shots use strictly increasing cut times.
promptingPolicySources.imageAnchoring: prompt-guide-base: with an anchoring image, describe forward development and do not duplicate what the image already shows.
promptingPolicySources.firstLastTrajectory: prompt-guide-base: first-frame state, intermediate change, then last-frame state; single-shot construction; no unrequested cuts.
promptingPolicySources.dialogue: prompt-guide-base: stable speaker identifiers, spoken content preserved verbatim, delivery and identification stated outside it.
promptingPolicySources.soundSeparation: prompt-guide-base: the soundscape field excludes dialogue and any music the characters can hear; non-diegetic music is directed separately.
promptingPolicySources.referenceSemantics: prompt-guide-ref: references are labelled and numbered per modality, and each definition states what it fixes - identity, environment, motion or voice.
